name: @asobacloud/odse-mcp

tools.name: ConvertToODSE
tools.description: Convert raw OEM energy telemetry (CSV/JSON text or file) into ODS-E energy-timeseries records using odse.transformer.transform. Optionally auto-detect the OEM when source is omitted.

payload.description: Raw telemetry payload text (CSV or JSON)

payload_file.description: Path to a telemetry file (relative paths resolve against ODSE_WORKSPACE)

source.description: OEM source key (e.g. huawei, enphase). If omitted, auto-detect from payload content.

asset_id.description: Optional asset id forwarded to odse.transform

tools.name: ListSupportedOEMs
tools.description: List OEM source keys supported by the installed odse package, plus the odse package version.

tools.name: ValidateODSERecord
tools.description: Validate a JSON array of ODS-E records using odse.validate_batch (package semantics).

records.description: JSON array of ODS-E record objects

stderr: [odse-mcp] Server ready. Workspace: /pkg. Tools: ConvertToODSE, ListSupportedOEMs, ValidateODSERecord
